proposal.name: Fetch captured drafting authority from the caller

plan.name: Fetch captured drafting authority from the caller
plan.summary: Replace modeled formalization's inline -draft-context JSON with a run-scoped, caller-owned loopback HTTP service that captures detached CheckContext bytes once, serves only authenticated GET requests, and has no operation to replace its authority; launch each checker with only -draft-context-endpoint, -draft-context-token and -draft-context-sha256, preserving -parent-plan. Add formalize.CheckContextReference (Endpoint, Token, SHA256 strings) and LoadCheckContext(context.Context, CheckContextReference, int) (CheckContext, error): fetch the exact JSON bytes with a fresh per-run bearer credential, verify their sha256: digest and expected parent before constructing the check tool or preparing verifiers, reject partial references, malformed or incomplete responses, substitution and unavailable authority, and bound the entire fetch to five seconds or the caller's earlier cancellation; an entirely absent reference preserves standalone checks, while the old inline flag is retired. Keep the service outside the drafting workspace and alive across provider retries and checker restarts, close and join it on return, setup failure or cancellation, and retain detached caller-memory copies for direct checks and independent final validation so visible context, baseline, previous, proposal and reader files cannot change authorized answers, revisions or comparison sources. Adapt the two existing fixtures that decode the old argument, extend the existing backend argument tests without relaxing any permission or tool assertions, and add offline regressions for contexts larger than 128 KiB, exact source recovery, both actual backend configurations, retries, restarts, tampering, concurrent runs and failure cleanup, preserving the existing parent-plan and final-comparison checks without changing agent network or file restrictions or implementing the conditional OrbStack migration. Update SPEC.md's caller-context contract and docs/statecharts.md to describe this transport, citing D-0014, D-0138, D-0139, D-0193, D-0355 and D-0362 along with the existing supporting decisions on each changed SPEC bullet; the merger records the transport refinement with the decision command, since this plumbing change cannot edit decisions/.

tests.name: TestDraftContext691CapturedService
tests.says: A normal formalization serves the exact detached context, including a model, includes, lock and large view exceeding 128 KiB, through an authenticated immutable service; short launch references survive repeated checker loads and the service closes when the run ends.

tests.name: TestDraftContext691RevisionsAndFinalCheck
tests.says: Fetched authority, direct checks and independent final validation agree on authorized and invented revisions despite edits to guidance and derived files.

tests.name: TestDraftContext691ConcurrentRunsAndCleanup
tests.says: Concurrent formalizations have independent credentials and immutable contexts; cancellation and backend setup failure close their services without closing another run's service.

tests.name: TestDraftContext691FetchFailures
tests.says: The checker refuses wrong credentials, digests and parents, partial references, malformed or substituted responses, service loss and stalled fetches, respects caller cancellation and a bounded startup deadline, and preserves a truly absent standalone context.

tests.name: TestDraftContext691BackendLaunches
tests.says: Both real backend launch paths generate bounded MCP configurations carrying only a short authority reference; offline provider stand-ins restart checker children across a retry, recover every captured byte, keep the original tool allowance, and preserve network and file restrictions.

tests.name: TestDraftContext691CLIRefusesInvalidAuthority
tests.says: The MCP command rejects invalid or incomplete caller authority before constructing a check tool or attempting verifier setup, rather than falling back to empty authority.
